_comment: The augmentation section's defaults: what the attacks draw (adversarial, to jailbreaks.csv) and what the variations draw (natural, to variations.csv). A recipe's augmentations overlays them key by key (layers, families and techniques list by list); a kind given as null is off. An empty layer_rates is the spec's rates. The attacks never draw a family of natural_only_families unless their families.allow names it. translation alone decides the translation family, whatever the lists say: false keeps it out, true puts it in. allow_request_obfuscation true deals a light encoding or a translation after the request to the share of the attacks' budget-round units the spec's request_obfuscation rate gives (0.5), in one of their max_obfuscations slots. A kind draws only the techniques whose kinds in combination_spec.json hold it, and its allow lists may name only those: the natural kind draws only what the spec marks natural, and no attack draws a family the spec marks natural alone (smalltalk_prefix, smalltalk_suffix, benign_role). A layer combination_spec.json has off by default (its layers_off_by_default: rewrite, whose 16 techniques are attacks only) is denied by every kind whose layers.allow does not name it, whatever its layers.deny says; to turn the rewrite layer on, a kind writes "layers": {"allow": ["rewrite"]} and, for budget rounds, its layer_rates give rewrite a rate above 0. Read by jailbreak/augmentation.py.

natural._comment_dialect: dialect runs on the translation model and is gated by the translation switch like the translation family: with translation true it is auto-added to this pool, so it is not named below; with translation false it is out.
